needed.evidence: No footway built on the left side of the road; people must walk in the road.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous and properly paved sidewalk on the left side of the road and ensure it is at least 1 metre wide.

needed.evidence: Right side sidewalk is narrow and partly blocked by obstructions.
needed.suggestion: Remove obstructions and widen the narrow sidewalk on the right side to at least 1 metre and ensure it remains unobstructed.

needed.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the right sidewalk can cause trip hazards.
needed.suggestion: Repave and smooth any uneven sections on the right sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and ensure a safe pedestrian pathway.

needed.evidence: Pedestrian demand to cross is high, but no crossing facility is present.
needed.suggestion: Install marked zebra crossings at frequent intervals where pedestrian demand is high, ensuring visibility and safety for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: No dropped kerbs visible at any potential crossing points.
needed.suggestion: Provide kerb ramps at all pedestrian crossings to allow smooth and safe transitions for wheelchair users and those with mobility issues.

needed.evidence: Insufficient street lighting along the urban roadway.
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lamps along the road to ensure adequate illumination for both vehicles and pedestrians.
